races.name: Sun Racing Free Tickets With Sun Club Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Premier Fantasy
runners_data.note: Forward-going style suits but 369 days off represents a significant freshness concern despite recent pointing success
runners_data.spotlight: Fair pointer with a 6-15 record (2m4f-3m, good to soft-good to firm: tongue-tied for five) for Bradley Gibbs; arrives on the back of a victory in a small-field mixed open when a short-priced favourite and looks the type to make an impact in this sphere; respected on hurdle/stable debut.

runners_data.name: Tiger Rouge
runners_data.note: Completely unknown quantity on hurdles debut after tailed-off point effort, making any assessment impossible
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to two winners, Skatman (useful 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Rockbrook (2m-2m3f hurdle/chase); tailed-off last of seven in a point bumper in March and has plenty to prove on rules debut.

runners_data.name: Tiger Tobin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with point success but poor recent form suggests significant decline in ability
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in a hunter chase on last year's rules debut and in a point in February
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden point winner in February 2024, but remains without further success and has struggled this year; faces a different test on hurdle/stable debut and will need to raise his game considerably.

runners_data.name: Brenda Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario but 100-1 debut effort suggests limited basic ability
runners_data.comment: Appealing pedigree but this is a belated racecourse debut
runners_data.spotlight: Related to several winners, including Dare To Endeavour (useful 2m4f-3m chase); 100-1 when soundly beaten on hurdle debut at Ffos Las (2m, good to soft) a fortnight ago; step up in trip should suit but likely one for longer term.

runners_data.name: Polemon
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up candidate with decent recent second, though pulling up last time raises stamina questions
runners_data.comment: Makes stable debut after absence but one of the likelier winners judged on Irish form
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (1m1f-1m4f) who showed promise in maiden hurdles but his progress stalled in spring 2025, pulling up on handicap hurdle debut and finishing well beaten on his final start for Denis Hogan in May last year; brought down at the first on stable debut after an absence this April (20-1), but still sets the standard with a mark of 110.

runners_data.name: River Don
runners_data.note: Sole leader will dictate terms but class concerns after tailed-off pointing effort following maiden win
runners_data.comment: Off mark at seventh attempt in points last month; cheekpieces on for rules/hurdle debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt in points when landing a five-runner maiden in April, but failed to build on that when tailed off and beating only one rival home on last month's hurdle debut over C&D; cheekpieces worn then quickly dispensed with and he needs to leave that effort well behind.

runners_data.name: French Diablo
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 168 days off and previous hanging issues create tactical uncertainties
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at 4-1 for his debut at Musselburgh (extended 1m7f, good to soft) in November and travelled with some promise before hanging badly left; failed to back that up when beaten 44l at Newbury the following month but remains open to improvement and this longer trip could suit; hood added.

runners_data.name: Yellow Card
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with much-improved recent second suggests return to form for in-form Mickey Bowen yard
runners_data.comment: 300-1 for a recent novice here and a long way behind Fairye Forth
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (AW and turf; 1m1f-1m4f) but form slumped after a promising start for this stable; however, he produced a much-improved effort when runner-up at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) last month on his fourth hurdle start and a repeat of that performance would give him leading claims.

runners_data.name: Keep Off The Sugar
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but three consecutive tailed-off efforts indicate serious underlying problems
runners_data.comment: Completely tailed off in two bumpers for this yard (hooded last time)
runners_data.spotlight: Made an encouraging start on bumper debut last March, but has gone backwards since and was tailed off on all three subsequent starts; offered little on last month's hurdling debut here (2m1f) after a break, and this longer trip needs to spark a major turnaround.

races.paceDynamic: River Don will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure him, allowing Harry Ryall's charge to dictate a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. The prominent runners Premier Fantasy, Tiger Tobin and French Diablo will track the leader but are unlikely to force a strong early pace given the distance. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace will build gradually from the back straight, creating opportunities for those who can quicken late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as they'll benefit from the modest early gallop and have fresher legs for the final climb.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If River Don sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing superior finishing speed up the hill. Yellow Card, Polemon and Keep Off The Sugar get perfect tactical setups to show their best.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply more pressure than expected on River Don from the home turn
scenarios.body: Premier Fantasy and Tiger Tobin get first run on the leader but avoid a stamina-sapping early battle. Their forward positions prove crucial when the hold-up horses find too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shock front-running success
scenarios.trigger: If River Don's early lead proves unassailable and no challenger can reel him in
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace plays perfectly to River Don's stamina strengths over this extended trip. His point-to-point victory at this distance becomes the key form reference as classier rivals fail to handle the tactical demands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a messy bunched finish where traffic problems decide the outcome. French Diablo's proven speed over shorter trips becomes a decisive asset in a cavalry charge finish.

watchPoints.text: River Don's jumping competence on hurdles debut, as any early mistakes could compromise his position as the only leader
Premier Fantasy's fitness after 369 days off, despite pointing preparation, as stamina could fade dramatically in the closing stages
Yellow Card's ability to reproduce his recent improved form, as previous inconsistency makes him unreliable despite tactical advantage
French Diablo's tendency to hang left returning on hurdles debut, which could compromise his position in the home straight
Tiger Rouge's market position given his complete unknown status, as any significant support would suggest stable confidence

races.name: Edmundson Electrical Torquay Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Franigane
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 33 days off with decent hunter chase form but faces first proper chase test at age 11 with significant weight burden.
runners_data.comment: Found only Barton Snow too good in this last year; not as convincing on sharper tracks.
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came in a 2m hurdle in February 2021 but long absences have interrupted his career in recent years; however, his hunter chase form reads notably well for a return to handicaps off what looks a workable mark on debut for Paul Nicholls and he won't be inconvenienced by any easing in the ground.

runners_data.name: Dunkerque
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with hat-trick form on similar going, perfectly suited to track the leader with William Shanahan's 5lb claim helping the cause.
runners_data.comment: 2m4f wins on good on last 2 starts (hurdle/chase); still feasibly treated; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick when winning at Kelso (extended 2m5f) ten days ago, making it 2-2 over fences, with all victories coming on good ground (handles soft); had a hard enough race there and shoulders a penalty here, so the booking of 5lb claimer William Shanahan looks a positive and another bold showing can be expected if this run doesn't come too soon.

runners_data.name: Doc McCoy
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace shape but winless over fences with recent unseating issues, though Isabelle Ryder's claim provides weight relief.
runners_data.comment: Useful hurdler but hasn't offered a lot over fences and a while since he tried them
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner but 0-6 over fences; hasn't had much go his way since scoring in October but he was still in contention when unseating three out over fences last time in a race won by Dunkerque; now 10lb better off with that rival and he should be competitive given a change in fortune; forecast rain is a concern though.

runners_data.name: Vengeance
runners_data.note: Hold-up style poorly suited to likely slow pace, but carries significant weight advantage and Jimmy Frost's yard is in decent form despite poor recent record.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-12 over hurdles and, while there have been hints of encouragement off a sliding mark, he hasn't looked like capitalising and now faces a stiff task from out of the weights on chase debut.

races.paceDynamic: Franigane will set the pace unopposed from the front, with Dunkerque and Doc McCoy settling prominently behind but unlikely to pressure the leader early in this small field. The sustainable gallop will allow Franigane to dictate terms through the middle sections, setting up a tactical finish where positioning becomes crucial. With only four runners and no genuine pressure on the leader, this race shape heavily favours prominent runners who can track the pace and have the tactical speed to strike, rather than hold-up horses who will struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Franigane jumps cleanly and isn't pressured through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist late challenges, benefiting from his front-running style in a race lacking early pace pressure. His hunter chase form suggests he retains ability despite the long absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dunkerque or Doc McCoy can position perfectly behind Franigane and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The hat-trick seeking Dunkerque or the talented but unlucky Doc McCoy can use their prominent style to track the leader before striking in the final furlong when the pace lifts. Their superior recent form and race fitness gives them the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Vengeance gets a dream scenario where his hold-up style suddenly becomes an asset in a messy, slowly-run affair that falls apart tactically. The 50lb weight advantage could prove decisive if the race becomes a stamina test rather than a speed contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Change Everything
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant jumping mistakes in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The race outcome becomes determined by who navigates the final few fences cleanest rather than tactical positioning or ability. Doc McCoy's recent unseating record or Franigane's long absence could prove costly when the pressure mounts.

watchPoints.text: Watch Franigane's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes could hand the initiative to Dunkerque tracking behind
Monitor Doc McCoy's confidence at the fences given his recent unseating habit when in contention
Check how aggressively Dunkerque positions early given his recent hat-trick form and confidence levels
Watch for Vengeance getting too far back in a small field where making up ground will be difficult
Observe if any of the prominent runners pressure Franigane earlier than expected, changing the whole race dynamic

races.name: Par Inn Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Isle Of Sark
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with 11 days freshness but concerning 0-8 chase record despite high class
runners_data.comment: Didn't build on previous good Sedgefield third latest; mixed record over stayers' trips.
runners_data.spotlight: Flat/hurdles winner; ran encouragingly on his return to chasing but has failed to back up that effort in two starts since, taking record in this sphere to 0-8; admittedly well treated on best form.

runners_data.name: Black Occ
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who backed up good Warwick effort, 25 days could sharpen him
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in 2 of 3 chase starts but creditable second in March (2m5f); should do better
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who has inconsistent chase form (P2P3) but looks one of the likelier players provided he backs up latest effort, namely creditable third at Warwick (3m); runs off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Kenzo Des Bruyeres
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose prominent style was compromised last time, Sean Bowen back aboard
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 under rules; had a plausible excuse (perhaps unsuited by being ridden much less prominently than usual) on chase debut last time; remains the type to do well in this sphere, being a dual point winner.

runners_data.name: It's A Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden from powerful Nicholls yard but worrying fall record recently
runners_data.comment: Fell four out on chase debut at Fontwell but he was close up at the time; dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who is one of the lesser lights at his major yard and has failed to complete in two starts since switched to fences; on a positive note, reproduction of best hurdles form would give him place claims.

runners_data.name: Daring Plan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid placing form but 68 days layoff raises fitness questions
runners_data.spotlight: Placed twice over shorter this year, runner-up at Fontwell (2m5f) last time; one of the main players on recent form but is no certainty to go one better, being 0-23 overall and not a certain stayer back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Ferando
runners_data.note: Prominent type switching to longer trip but unreliable maiden with poor completion rate
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who is 0-4 over hurdles and fences apiece (2m-2m6f); far from solid on form and chance largely depends on the effects of new trip.

runners_data.name: Winning Paddy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fade tendency who drops to handicap level for first time
runners_data.comment: 1-11 in Irish points; faces a tough task on British/stable debut switching to hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Record of only 1-11 in points and is far from solid on rules form (three attempts); however, may show the benefit of switching to handicap level off a modest mark.

runners_data.name: Bee's Kiss
runners_data.note: Hold-up point winner who is 8lb out of handicap but may improve switching to chasing
runners_data.spotlight: Has poor claims on rules form and is 8lb out of weights but may improve for this switch to chasing, being a point winner.

races.paceDynamic: Kenzo Des Bruyeres will establish the lead with no other confirmed front runners in the field. The prominent runners Daring Plan, Ferando and Winning Paddy will likely settle just behind, but none are aggressive pace-pressers, allowing Kenzo Des Bruyeres to dictate at a manageable tempo. This sustainable pace setup will create a tactical affair where the race develops gradually, with the real test coming over the final half-mile when stamina becomes crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the even gallop and deliver late kicks, particularly Isle Of Sark, Black Occ and Bee's Kiss.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres is allowed to control the tempo without serious pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test where horses with tactical speed can pick off the leaders in the final furlong. Hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres jumps fluently and maintains a strong gallop that stretches the field
scenarios.body: His class advantage shows as the pace becomes genuinely testing, and prominent runners struggle to bridge the gap. The leader's superior rating tells as chasers fail to reel him in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Daring Plan or Ferando press forward to challenge Kenzo Des Bruyeres entering the home straight
scenarios.body: The increased tempo puts pressure on hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground on the leaders. Prominent runners with tactical pace get first run on horses tracking them.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres makes jumping errors or the pace becomes crawling slow through lack of pressure
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of running style. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Kenzo Des Bruyeres jumping - any early mistakes could unsettle his rhythm and compromise the even pace scenario
Isle Of Sark's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance given his 0-8 chase record suggests finishing limitations
Daring Plan's fitness after 68-day break - any signs of rustiness could rule out his prominent challenge
It's A Breeze completing the course - recent fall record makes him a non-completion risk
Black Occ's jumping rhythm early - needs to travel well to justify his consistent recent form

races.name: Charles Darrow Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Queens Venture
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won twice here last summer and brings the highest RPR into this contest despite disappointing recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Ran well for long way at Hereford this month, after a break; could have a say
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a double (2m6f/2m5f, good/good to soft) when winning here for Dan Skelton last August; she's run some reasonable races since for this yard but was a well-beaten second of two finishers at Fontwell recently.

runners_data.name: Porter In The Park
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with proven stamina over this trip but concerning strike-rate from Emma Lavelle's yard this season
runners_data.comment: Run of place finishes halted latest; races off her last winning mark back down in class.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up at Warwick (3m2f, good to soft) in March under regular rider Cameron Johnstone-Baker and she's firmly in the picture on that form but two lesser performances have followed and she needs something extra.

runners_data.name: Jena d'Oudairies
runners_data.note: Prominent racer on a roll with back-to-back wins in first-time blinkers for in-form Paul Nicholls stable
runners_data.comment: Led close home in new blinkers last month; still on a good mark and unexposed as a stayer
runners_data.spotlight: Won in first-time blinkers (retained since) at Taunton (3m, good) in April and had 9l to spare when following up at Stratford (3m2f, good to firm); also effective on soft/good to soft; climbing the weights but leading claims nevertheless.

runners_data.name: Miss Goldfire
runners_data.note: Prominent type who returned to form at Fontwell last time but carries the burden of an unseated rider on her most recent appearance
runners_data.comment: Bounced back to form with C&D win this month and remains on workable mark after 5lb rise
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form to win under Ciaran O'Shea at Fontwell (2m5f, good) last month; unseated before the race got serious there last time; stays 3m2f and is effective on good to soft ground; capable of having a big say.

runners_data.name: Just A Memory
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping back to hurdles after a decent chase second but faces a significant class rise against these opponents
runners_data.comment: Has won over fences but no positives to take from her last three races
runners_data.spotlight: Won over fences here (2m5f, good to soft) last September and she returned to form when runner-up in a chase at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) a fortnight ago; 0-6 over hurdles but showed promise in this sphere earlier in her career; could have a part to play if her good form continues.

races.paceDynamic: Porter In The Park will take the field along at a steady gallop over this stamina test, with Queens Venture, Jena d'Oudairies and Miss Goldfire all positioned prominently behind. The presence of multiple prominent racers means Porter In The Park won't face early pressure, allowing her to dictate a manageable rhythm through the early stages. This creates a tactical race where positioning and timing becomes crucial, with the pace likely to quicken significantly from three out as the field closes up. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and strike at the right moment rather than horses needing to come from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Porter In The Park sets steady fractions and the field stays bunched until the business end
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical affair where horses tracking the pace can time their challenge perfectly. Queens Venture or Miss Goldfire can use their class advantage to strike decisively in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Maintains Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Porter In The Park faces no early pressure and gets into an ideal rhythm
scenarios.body: She can utilise her stamina advantage over this extended trip, building an unassailable lead from the home turn. Her recent Warwick second suggests she has the engine for a bold front-running display.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nicholls Runner Improves Again
scenarios.trigger: If Jena d'Oudairies continues her upward trajectory from recent wins
scenarios.body: Her momentum from back-to-back victories and the master trainer's 4/13 strike-rate suggests further improvement is possible. The step up in class may not stop a mare clearly going the right way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong and the principals tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Just A Memory can pick up the pieces despite her lower rating, using her proven stamina at this course. Her recent chase second shows she retains ability despite her hurdles record.

watchPoints.text: Porter In The Park could get an uncontested lead if the other prominent racers are content to sit and wait too long
Miss Goldfire's confidence after that unseated incident at Fontwell - any signs of hesitancy at the hurdles could prove costly
Jena d'Oudairies wearing blinkers for the third time - check if she settles better or becomes more keen early on
Just A Memory stepping back to hurdles from chasing - watch for any jumping errors as she readjusts to the smaller obstacles
Cameron Johnstone-Baker's 7lb claim on Porter In The Park effectively makes her the topweight in this handicap

races.name: Clearance Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Centara
runners_data.note: Front runner returning to his favoured 2m trip after the longer distance seemed to stretch him last time, 28 days off ideal for Nicholls stable
runners_data.comment: Five chase wins last summer; second wind op; steps up in trip but needs to find more.
runners_data.spotlight: Highly progressive over fences in the first half of last season, winning here four times (2m, good to soft/good); 2m5f here appeared to stretch him last month following some time off; has a lower mark to work with back over hurdles and he could play a leading role back down in trip.

runners_data.name: Howth
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent course form who has been off for 255 days but showed his best form on good ground over this course and distance
runners_data.spotlight: Switched to hurdles for new yard last May-September and won four of his six starts (all on good ground), two of them over C&D (one a handicap); held in fourth of six at Plumpton last September when last seen but retains potential; yard among the winners and he could go well back from a break.

runners_data.name: American Land
runners_data.note: Proven course winner with strong recent form who should be ideally placed to track the leader and strike late under an experienced pilot
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific between November 2024 and June 2025, with his four wins in that spell including two here; his progress seemed to stall subsequently but he ran well when second of five to a progressive winner at Chepstow (2m, good) last time and could be in the mix; effective on good to soft.

runners_data.name: Arctic Voyage
runners_data.note: Young hold-up performer on the upgrade but may struggle if the pace becomes tactical with only one front runner to aim at
runners_data.comment: Penalised for his clearcut Hereford win but has less to prove than most of these
runners_data.spotlight: Useful on testing ground on the Flat early in career and this 4yo has tapped back into that promise over hurdles this spring, winning a maiden at Hereford (2m, good) in April on his second stable start and following up in a C&D novice (good); trainer won this with Clearance, after whom this race is named, in 2022 and 2024; intriguing candidate back in a handicap.

runners_data.name: Morning Mayhem
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has shown his best form on softer ground and needs a strong pace to be maximally effective in this small field
runners_data.comment: 2m course winnner in March and looked shade unlucky over 2m2f at Stratford on latest start
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins for new stable last season (2m, heavy-good to soft) and he's continued in good form, beaten only 1l when fourth at Fakenham (2m4f, good) last month; the drop back in trip could help; firmly in calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Centara will take this field along at a sensible gallop from the front, with no other confirmed pace-setters to pressure him early. The prominent runners Howth and American Land will track behind the leader, while Arctic Voyage and Morning Mayhem settle towards the rear with their hold-up styles. With only five runners and a single pace-setter, this sets up as a tactical affair where the tempo may not be strong enough to set up the hold-up horses. This race shape favours prominent runners who can sit close to Centara and pick him up in the straight when the pace inevitably quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Centara sets a steady tempo without burning off the field early
scenarios.body: The pace won't be strong enough to bring the hold-up horses into play, allowing those tracking the leader to strike at the right time. Howth and American Land are perfectly positioned to capitalize when Centara comes back to them.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Centara gets an uncontested lead and maintains his stamina advantage
scenarios.body: His class edge and Paul Nicholls training allows him to repel all challengers despite carrying top weight. The lack of early pressure means he has enough left to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run from the home turn onwards
scenarios.body: Arctic Voyage or Morning Mayhem can take advantage of a collapse up front as the early leaders pay for their efforts. Their fresh finishing kick proves decisive in a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys go too slow early and create a messy, stop-start race
scenarios.body: The small field and lack of pace pressure creates a tactical nightmare where any horse can win from anywhere. Form and class become secondary to who gets the best run and timing in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Centara goes too slow early - in a five-runner field with no pace pressure, he could dictate terms completely and prove hard to peg back
Watch Howth's fitness after 255 days off - his class is proven here but ring rustiness could be crucial in a tight finish
Watch the tempo from the home turn - if it doesn't quicken significantly, the hold-up horses Arctic Voyage and Morning Mayhem will struggle
Watch American Land's jumping under pressure - he has the tactical speed to win but needs to be fluent at the obstacles when the race heats up
Watch for any early tactical maneuvering - with such a small field, positioning battles could develop that disrupt the expected pace scenario

races.name: WestCountry Food Supplies Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ugo Bingo
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner, returns to last winning mark but 52 days off and cheekpieces back on suggest connections targeting this
runners_data.comment: A wilting fourth in this new headgear here last time and remains below his best
runners_data.spotlight: Has slipped to his last winning mark but he's proving difficult to win with and was well held at Wincanton in April last time; cheekpieces return and, while he copes with most ground, he's likely to be playing for minor honours at best.

runners_data.name: Zambezi Fix
runners_data.note: Hold-up style veteran struggling for form since October, 53 days off and needs career-best effort at age 11
runners_data.spotlight: Has been struggling for form since reappearing in October and offered little encouragement on April's return from just over two months off; has come a long way down in the weights and drops into a Class 5, but that's for good reason and he needs to turn things around.

runners_data.name: Peace Motivator
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who has failed to complete in all five hurdle starts including last month's stable debut
runners_data.comment: Pulled up when 80-1 for recent stable/handicap debut; headgear switched here
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner for Olly Murphy in 2024 but has failed to complete in all five hurdle starts, including when pulled up on last month's handicap/stable debut; swaps hood for first-time cheekpieces but hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Westerton
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well when second at Warwick last time, only 14 days ago and 5lb rise looks manageable
runners_data.comment: Beaten 29l on stable debut at Uttoxeter 18 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Built on the promise of his seasonal return when a close second at Warwick (2m, good) last month, despite making a mistake at the last; a 5lb rise asks a little more, though Lewis Stones's 3lb claim helps offset that, and he still looks favourably treated on his best Flat form; with further progress likely, he's high on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Ambassador
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose form has collapsed since August win, 50 days off and showing no revival signs
runners_data.comment: Won at Cartmel in August but his form has nosedived since
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Cartmel (2m1f) in August but form has slumped badly since and he has shown no sign of a revival in two runs since returning from a break in April.

runners_data.name: Lord Cauvelliere
runners_data.note: Hold-up type improving in handicaps after disappointing in novice hurdles, good ground form looks solid
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutant who is interesting on the form of his bumper win last May
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who failed to transfer that ability in three novice hurdle runs last year, but showed more switched to handicaps at Ludlow (2m, good) last month when keeping on after a mistake at the last; likely has more to offer and is one to consider eased slightly in the weights; unraced on ground worse than good.

runners_data.name: Get The Value
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse formerly useful here but badly out of form since December, now 4lb below last winning mark
runners_data.comment: Exposed 8yo who has been out of sorts in five runs following a break
runners_data.spotlight: Completed back-to-back wins last spring, including one here, but has been badly out of form since returning from a break in December; now 4lb below his last winning mark, but hard to make a case for in current form.

runners_data.name: Marhaba The Champ
runners_data.note: Hold-up type largely disappointing for stable, 207 days off and last ran when refusing to start on Flat
runners_data.comment: Comfortably held since sold last July; 17lb below peak mark but no win since 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Largely disappointing for this stable under both codes and, after a brief respite on the Flat at Newbury in April, he refused to come out of the stalls at York last month, both times in this headgear; best hurdle effort when runner-up at Newcastle (2m1f, good) in October offers some hope on handicap switch, but current form is a clear concern.

runners_data.name: Jukebox Annie
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare making little impact in handicaps, 146 days off and was well-backed but failed last time
runners_data.spotlight: Has made little impact since switched to handicaps and, though well supported at Taunton (2m, good) in January, failed to justify the money, struggling a long way out and eventually pulling up; off since and now 14lb lower than her opening mark but can only be watched at present.

runners_data.name: Warfleet
runners_data.note: Hold-up type showing nothing over hurdles after bumper promise, tailed off on both starts since switch
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise when runner-up in one of three bumpers in 2024 but he's shown nothing worthwhile since switched to hurdles, finishing tailed off on both runs since returning from an absence in April; makes handicap debut off a lowly mark but with plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Cogital
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran hard to predict, hasn't raced over hurdles since good second at Chepstow in March
runners_data.spotlight: Not the easiest to predict and well held on both starts on the AW since finishing a good second over hurdles at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) in March, ridden by Harry Atkins who can claim his 5lb allowance here; will not mind any rain and not out of this if in the mood, with one of his two hurdling wins coming over C&D.

runners_data.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching to handicaps after offering little in three novice hurdle runs, tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (1m2f/1m4f); has offered little in three runs over hurdles for this stable but may fare better now switched to handicaps with a tongue-tie added.

races.paceDynamic: Ugo Bingo will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this field, creating a sustainable tempo early. Ambassador and potentially Westerton may track prominently behind the leader, but the majority of this field consists of hold-up horses including Zambezi Fix, Get The Value, Lord Cauvelliere, and Marhaba The Champ. With one uncontested leader and numerous hold-up types, this sets up a moderate gallop that will quicken late, creating a strong staying test over this 2m1f trip. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Ugo Bingo gets an easy lead and isn't pressured until late.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes to challenge. Prominent racers like Ambassador can track the tempo and strike late when others are still making ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Westerton or another prominent runner applies early pressure to Ugo Bingo.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits those positioned handy who can quicken off a solid pace, while stretching the stamina of the hold-up horses. Fresh legs positioned close to the pace can exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field bunches up turning for home.
scenarios.body: A tactical affair allows the better-class hold-up horses with superior finishing kicks to overcome positioning. The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with class telling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If there are multiple fallers or the pace collapses completely.
scenarios.body: Field becomes strung out and fragmented, allowing an unconsidered runner with a clear run to pick up the pieces. Form horses struggle with the disrupted rhythm.

watchPoints.text: Ugo Bingo must be watched for market support given his front-running advantage and return to last winning mark
Peace Motivator has never completed a hurdle race in five attempts and poses a potential pace disruption risk
Westerton carrying a 5lb penalty for his Warwick second but showed improved jumping that day
Marhaba The Champ returning after 207 days off including a refusal to start last time out
Multiple hold-up horses could create traffic problems in the home straight with limited early pace

runners_data.name: Matty's Mate
runners_data.spotlight: £135,000 3yo; brother to winners He Can't Dance (useful bumper/3m hurdle) and Musique De Fee (2m5f-3m3f hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to top-class 2m chaser Master Minded and two French Listed winners; represents highly notable connections; respected debutant.

runners_data.name: Mr Sunny
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam 1m/9.4f AW winner (RPR 58), out of maiden half-sister to 1m2f-1m4f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Middlethorpe; less interesting than stablemate Ocean Rose on breeding.

runners_data.name: Thepassingtyphoon
runners_data.spotlight: Dam runner-up in 2m/2m5f hurdles, out of bumper/1m6f Flat winner; yard has a poor strike-rate in bumpers.

runners_data.name: Winter Flight
runners_data.spotlight: Rules debutant who isn't particularly compelling on point form; the betting may offer further guidance.

runners_data.name: Ocean Rose
runners_data.spotlight: 10,000euros foal; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, sister to winners Twelve Roses (useful bumper and 2m3f-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Cinderella Rose (bumper/2m-2m5f hurdle), out of bumper winner, is granddaughter of Stayers' Hurdle winner Rose Ravine; likely type on breeding.

runners_data.name: Megatothemax
runners_data.spotlight: Closely related to winners Rathhill (useful 2m hurdle) and Vegas Blue (bumper including Listed/2m3f hurdle), half-sister to bumper/hurdle winner Josie Abbing; dam maiden close relative of top-class jumper up to 3m1f Bellshill; stable 1-1 in bumpers this term; interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Roccana Rose
runners_data.spotlight: Dam placed in French 2m3f hurdles, half-sister to winners Honeysuckle (multiple 2m-2m4f Grade 1 hurdle including two Champion Hurdles) and Last Royal (bumper/2m5f hurdle); has had wind surgery; wears tongue-tie and hood on debut; heed the market signals.

runners_data.name: Three Of Spades
runners_data.spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; sibling to three Flat winners, notably Make Time (Group-placed 7f 2yo/1m; RPR 109); dam 7f winner (87), half-sister to 6f Group 2 winner Overdose; yard not associated with bumper scorers.

runners_data.name: Five Lanes
runners_data.comment: Ran out on last month's debut in British maiden point; may be best watched on bumper debut
runners_data.spotlight: The only contender with bumper form but sets a poor standard, having trailed home last of four at Hereford; ran out in a point prior to that rules debut.
